title: New Vendor starts on COD whatever the customer default is
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Net 30 is the shop's default for new customers.
  • A name for the new vendor, {Vendor-A}.
    For example: {Vendor-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S6-02 Vendor.
  • Starting screen: Parts, Vendors.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Vendor".
  2. Type {Vendor-A} in Name.
  3. Click Save & Close.
  4. Open {Vendor-A}'s vendor page.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the "New Vendor" window opens. It reads COD (not Net 30).
  • Step 2: the field shows the name as typed.
  • Step 3: the vendor is saved.
  • Step 4: the "Credit term" reads COD.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11675 (Story 6, Vendors)

  • S6-R2: “New Vendor starts on COD, as today. The shop's default does not apply to vendors, and the vendor dropdown shows no "Default" tag.”
  • Out of Scope: “A separate default term for new vendors. New vendors keep starting on COD. Whether vendors get their own default is a follow-up decision (open question on the review page).”
  • Feature Overview: “Customers and vendors share one term list. The shop's default applies to new customers only; new vendors keep starting on COD.”
